<style>
				/* --- Cấu trúc Layout chính --- */
				#ticket-dashboard-container {
					font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
					width: 100%;
					height: 100vh;
					display: flex;
					flex-direction: column;
					overflow: hidden;
					background-color: transparent;
				}
				
				#ticket-dashboard-container *,
				#ticket-dashboard-container *:before,
				#ticket-dashboard-container *:after {
					box-sizing: border-box;
				}

				/* --- Header --- */
				#ticket-dashboard-container .header-wrapper {
					flex: 0 0 auto;
					padding: 20px 24px 10px 24px;
					z-index: 10;
				}

				#ticket-dashboard-container .header-section-ticketDashboard {
					display: flex;
					justify-content: space-between;
					align-items: center;
					padding: 12px 24px; /* Giảm padding một chút cho gọn */
					border-radius: 8px;
					border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
                    border-left: 5px solid #00673b; /* Highlight viền trái */
				}

				/* Group text bên trái header */
				#ticket-dashboard-container .header-content {
					display: flex;
					flex-direction: column;
					gap: 2px;
				}

				#ticket-dashboard-container .welcome-text {
                    font-size: 24px; /* Tăng cỡ chữ */
                    font-weight: 800; /* Tăng độ đậm */
                    color: #00673b;
                    text-shadow: 0px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); /* Thêm bóng chữ nhẹ cho nổi */
                    margin-bottom: 4px; /* Thêm khoảng cách */
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .company-subtext {
                    font-size: 14px;
                    font-weight: 600;
                    color: #4b5563; /* Màu xám đậm hơn chút để dễ đọc */
                    text-transform: uppercase;
                    letter-spacing: 1px; /* Tăng khoảng cách chữ cho sang */
                }

				#ticket-dashboard-container .create-ticket-btn {
					padding: 10px 20px;
					border: 1px solid #00673b; /* Đổi viền theo màu chủ đạo luôn cho đồng bộ */
					
					color: #00673b;
					border-radius: 6px;
					cursor: pointer;
					font-size: 14px;
					font-weight: 600;
					display: flex;
					align-items: center;
					gap: 8px;
					transition: all 0.2s ease;
				}
				#ticket-dashboard-container .create-ticket-btn:hover {
					background: #f0fdf4; /* Hover màu xanh lá nhạt */
				}

				/* --- Layout 2 cột --- */
				#ticket-dashboard-container .dashboard-layout {
					flex: 1;
					display: grid;
					grid-template-columns: 1fr 400px;
					gap: 24px;
					padding: 10px 24px 20px 24px;
					overflow: hidden;
					min-height: 0;
				}

				#ticket-dashboard-container .scroll-column {
					height: 100%;
					overflow-y: auto;
					padding-right: 4px;
					padding-bottom: 20px;
					-ms-overflow-style: none;
					scrollbar-width: none;
				}
				#ticket-dashboard-container .scroll-column::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

				/* --- Cards & Stats --- */
				#ticket-dashboard-container .stats-grid {
					display: grid;
					grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
					gap: 20px;
					margin-bottom: 24px;
				}

				/* --- Sửa lại Style cho Stat Card --- */
				#ticket-dashboard-container .stat-card {
					padding: 20px;
					border-radius: 8px;
					border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
					position: relative;
					/* Chuyển sang xếp ngang để icon và nội dung nằm cạnh nhau */
					display: flex;
					flex-direction: row;
					align-items: center;
					justify-content: space-between; /* Đẩy dropdown sang phải cùng */
				}

				/* Color highlights giữ nguyên */
				#ticket-dashboard-container .stat-card::before {
					content: ""; position: absolute; top: 12px; bottom: 12px; left: 0; width: 4px;
					border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px;
				}
				#ticket-dashboard-container .stat-card.total::before { background: #10b981; }
				#ticket-dashboard-container .stat-card.new::before { background: #3b82f6; }
				#ticket-dashboard-container .stat-card.onleave::before { background: #f59e0b; }

				/* Gom nhóm Icon và Text */
				#ticket-dashboard-container .stat-main-content {
					display: flex;
					align-items: center;
					gap: 16px; /* Khoảng cách giữa icon và chữ */
				}

				#ticket-dashboard-container .stat-icon {
					width: 48px; height: 48px; /* Tăng kích thước icon chút cho cân đối */
					border-radius: 8px;
					border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
					display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
					color: #64748b;
					flex-shrink: 0; /* Không cho icon bị co lại */
				}
				#ticket-dashboard-container .stat-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: currentColor; }

				/* Phần chữ xếp dọc (Label trên, Value dưới hoặc ngược lại) */
				#ticket-dashboard-container .stat-text-group {
					display: flex;
					flex-direction: column;
					justify-content: center;
				}

				#ticket-dashboard-container .stat-value {
					font-size: 24px;
					font-weight: 700;
					line-height: 1.2;
				}

				#ticket-dashboard-container .stat-label {
					font-size: 13px;
					color: #64748b;
					font-weight: 500;
				}

				/* --- Charts & General Card Box --- */
				#ticket-dashboard-container .charts-grid {
					display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px;
				}
				#ticket-dashboard-container .card-box {
					
					padding: 24px;
					border-radius: 8px;
					border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
					margin-bottom: 24px;
				}
				#ticket-dashboard-container .charts-grid .card-box { margin-bottom: 0; }

				#ticket-dashboard-container .card-title {
					font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #00673b; margin-bottom: 20px;
					display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
				}
				#ticket-dashboard-container .chart-canvas { width: 100%; height: 250px; }

				/* --- List Items --- */
				#ticket-dashboard-container .info-item, #ticket-dashboard-container .user-item {
					display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
					padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
				}
				#ticket-dashboard-container .info-item:last-child, #ticket-dashboard-container .user-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
				#ticket-dashboard-container .user-item { gap: 12px; justify-content: flex-start; }
				/* --- Sửa lại Style cho Item trong Sidebar --- */
				#ticket-dashboard-container .user-item {
					display: flex;
					align-items: center; /* Căn giữa theo chiều dọc */
					gap: 12px;
					padding: 12px 0;
					border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
				}

				#ticket-dashboard-container .user-info {
                    flex: 1;
                    min-width: 0; /* Quan trọng: cho phép flex item co lại nhỏ hơn content */
                    display: flex;
                    flex-direction: column;
                    gap: 3px;
                    overflow: hidden; /* Thêm dòng này */
                }

				/* Dòng 1: Tiêu đề Ticket */
				#ticket-dashboard-container .ticket-title-text {
                    font-size: 14px;
                    font-weight: 600;
                    white-space: nowrap;
                    overflow: hidden;
                    text-overflow: ellipsis;
                    max-width: 100%; /* Thêm dòng này */
                    flex: 1; /* Thêm dòng này để chiếm hết không gian còn lại */
                }

				/* Dòng 2: Nhân viên + Ngày */
				#ticket-dashboard-container .ticket-sub-row {
					font-size: 12px;
					color: #64748b;
					display: flex;
					align-items: center;
				}

				/* Dấu chấm hoặc gạch ngăn cách (nếu cần) */
				#ticket-dashboard-container .ticket-sub-divider {
					margin: 0 6px;
					color: #cbd5e1;
				}
				#ticket-dashboard-container .user-avatar {
					width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%;
					border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
					 color: #2563eb;
					display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0;
				}
				#ticket-dashboard-container .user-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
				#ticket-dashboard-container .user-name {
					font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;
					white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
				}
				#ticket-dashboard-container .user-role { font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; }
				#ticket-dashboard-container .status-badge {
					padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px;
					font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; margin-left: auto;
					border: 1px solid currentColor;
					background: transparent;
				}
				#ticket-dashboard-container select {
					padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
					border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; outline: none;
				}
                /* --- Filter Panel Styles --- */
                #ticket-dashboard-container .header-actions {
                    display: flex;
                    align-items: center;
                    gap: 12px;
                    justify-content: flex-end;
                }
                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-bar-slide {
                    display: flex;
                    align-items: center;
                    gap: 8px;

                    /* Thiết lập hiệu ứng trượt */
                    max-width: 0;
                    opacity: 0;
                    overflow: hidden; /* Giấu nội dung khi đóng */
                    white-space: nowrap; /* Không xuống dòng */
                    transition: all 0.4s ease-in-out;
                }

                /* Khi có class .open thì hiện ra */
                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-bar-slide.open {
                    max-width: 800px; /* Đủ rộng để chứa hết input */
                    opacity: 1;
                    margin-right: 8px; /* Khoảng cách với nút icon */
                }
                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-group {
                    display: flex;
                    align-items: center;
                    gap: 8px;
                }
                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-toggle-btn {
                    padding: 0;
                    width: 36px;
                    height: 36px;
                    border: 1px solid #00673b;
                    color: #00673b;
                    border-radius: 6px;
                    cursor: pointer;
                    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
                    transition: all 0.2s ease;
                }
                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-toggle-btn:hover,
                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-toggle-btn.active {
                    background: #00673b;
                    color: white;
                }
                
                #ticket-dashboard-container .action-buttons-group {
                    display: flex;
                    align-items: center;
                    gap: 12px;
                }
                
                #ticket-dashboard-container .date-range-group {
                    display: flex;
                    align-items: center;
                    gap: 8px;
                    flex-shrink: 0;
                }

                /* Nút Reset (Icon nhỏ) */
                #ticket-dashboard-container .btn-reset-icon {
                    width: 30px; height: 30px;
                    border: none; background: transparent;
                    color: #94a3b8; cursor: pointer;
                    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
                }
                #ticket-dashboard-container .btn-reset-icon:hover { color: #ef4444; }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-panel {
                    position: absolute;
                    top: calc(100% + 8px);
                    right: 0;
                    border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
                    border-radius: 8px;
                    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
                    padding: 16px;
                    min-width: 650px;
                    display: none;
              z-index: 1000;
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-panel.open {
                    display: block;
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-content {
                    display: flex;
                    gap: 12px;
                    align-items: center;
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-input,
                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-select {
                    height: 36px;
                    padding: 0 10px;
                    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
                    border-radius: 6px;
                    font-size: 13px;
                    outline: none;
                    line-height: normal;
                    box-sizing: border-box;
                    width: auto; /* Tự động theo nội dung hoặc set cứng bên dưới */
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-select {
                    width: 160px; /* Select box rộng hơn chút để hiển thị tên */
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-input:focus,
                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-select:focus {
                    border-color: #00673b;
                    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 103, 59, 0.1);
                }
                #ticket-dashboard-container .btn-reset-icon {
                    width: 36px;
                    height: 36px;
                    display: flex;
                    align-items: center;
                    justify-content: center;
                    border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
                    border-radius: 6px;
                    color: #64748b;
                    cursor: pointer;
                    transition: all 0.2s;
                }
                #ticket-dashboard-container .btn-reset-icon:hover {
                    background: #f1f5f9;
                    color: #ef4444;
                    border-color: #cbd5e1;
                }
                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-input::placeholder {
                    color: #94a3b8;
                    font-size: 13px;
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-actions {
                    display: flex;
                    gap: 8px;
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-btn {
                    padding: 8px 16px;
                    border-radius: 6px;
                    font-size: 13px;
                    font-weight: 600;
                    cursor: pointer;
                    transition: all 0.2s ease;
                    white-space: nowrap;
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-btn.apply {
                    background: #00673b;
                    color: white;
                    border: 1px solid #00673b;
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-btn.apply:hover {
                    background: #005230;
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-btn.reset {
                    color: #64748b;
                    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-btn.reset:hover {
                    background: #f8fafc;
                }

                /* --- Chart Legend Styles --- */
                #ticket-dashboard-container .chart-legend {
                    margin-top: 16px;
                    display: flex;
                    flex-wrap: wrap;
                    gap: 12px;
                    justify-content: center;
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .legend-item {
                    display: flex;
                    align-items: center;
                    gap: 6px;
                    font-size: 12px;
                    color: #64748b;
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .legend-color {






                    width: 12px;
                    height: 12px;
                    border-radius: 2px;
                }
                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-input[type="date"] {
                    width: 137px;
                    display: flex;
                    align-items: center;
                    font-family: inherit;
                }
                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-input[type="date"]::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator {
                    cursor: pointer;
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-input[type="date"]:before {
                    content: attr(placeholder);
                    color: #94a3b8;
                    margin-right: 8px;
                }

                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-input[type="date"]:focus:before,
                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-input[type="date"]:valid:before {
                    content: "";
                }
                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-input[type="date"] { width: 136px; }
                #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-select { width: 150px; }
				/* Responsive */
				@media (max-width: 1024px) {
					#ticket-dashboard-container .dashboard-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; overflow-y: auto; }
					#ticket-dashboard-container .scroll-column { overflow-y: visible; height: auto; }
					#ticket-dashboard-container .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; }
				}
				@media (max-width: 768px) {
                    #ticket-dashboard-container .header-wrapper {
                        padding: 12px 12px 6px 12px;
                    }
                    #ticket-dashboard-container .header-section-ticketDashboard {
                        flex-direction: column;
                        align-items: stretch;
                        gap: 10px;
                        padding: 16px;
                        border-left-width: 4px;
                    }
                    #ticket-dashboard-container .welcome-text {
                        font-size: 20px;
                    }
                    #ticket-dashboard-container .header-actions {
                        width: 100%;
                        flex-direction: column;
                        align-items: stretch;
                        gap: 12px;
                    }
                    
                    #ticket-dashboard-container .action-buttons-group {
                        width: 100%;
                        justify-content: flex-end;
                        gap: 8px;
                        order: 2; /* Đưa xuống dưới */
                    }
                    
                    #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-bar-slide {
                        order: 1; /* Đưa lên trên */
                    }

                    #ticket-dashboard-container .date-range-group {
                        width: 100%;
                        justify-content: space-between;
                    }

                    /* Sửa lại bộ lọc trên mobile: Hiển thị gọn gàng hơn */
                    #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-bar-slide {
                        position: relative;
                        display: flex;
                        flex-direction: column; /* Đổi về column để chứa các row */
                        align-items: stretch;
                        width: 100%;
                        gap: 8px;
                        max-height: 0;
                        opacity: 0;
                        margin: 0 !important;
                        padding: 0;
                        overflow: hidden;
                        transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
                    }
                    #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-bar-slide.open {
                        max-height: 500px;
                        opacity: 1;
                        padding-top: 10px;
                        border-top: 1px dashed #e2e8f0;
                        margin-top: 10px !important;
                    }
                    
                    #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-input, 
                    #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-select { 
                        width: 100% !important;
                        min-width: 0;
                        background-color: #f8fafc;
                    }
                    
                    #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-input[type="date"] {
                        flex: 1;
                        width: auto !important;
                    }
                    
                    #ticket-dashboard-container .filter-bar-slide span {
                        display: inline-block; /* Hiện lại dấu gạch ngang */
                    }

					#ticket-dashboard-container .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; }
					#ticket-dashboard-container .charts-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 16px; }
                    #ticket-dashboard-container .dashboard-layout { padding: 10px 16px; gap: 16px; }
				}
			</style>

			<div id="ticket-dashboard-container">
				<div class="header-wrapper">
					<div class="header-section-ticketDashboard">
						<div class="header-content">
							<div class="welcome-text">Chào mừng quay trở lại!</div>

										<polygon points="22 3 2 3 10 12.46 10 19 14 21 14 12.46 22 3"></polygon>

						</div>
					</div>

    <div class="dashboard-layout">

                        <div class="stat-icon" style="color: #10b981; background: #ecfdf5; border-color: #d1fae5;">
                            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"></path><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"></circle><path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"></path><path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"></path></svg>

                            <div class="stat-label">Tổng ticket</div>
                            <div class="stat-value" id="lbl_TotalTickets">0</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="stat-card new">
                    <div class="stat-main-content">
                        <div class="stat-icon" style="color: #3b82f6; background: #eff6ff; border-color: #dbeafe;">
                            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"></path><polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"></polyline><line x1="16" y1="13" x2="8" y2="13"></line><line x1="16" y1="17" x2="8" y2="17"></line><polyline points="10 9 9 9 8 9"></polyline></svg>

        function drawBarChart(labels, dataValues) {
            // Đảm bảo ID khớp với HTML
            var canvas = document.getElementById('barChart');
            if (!canvas) {
                console.error("Không tìm thấy canvas #barChart");
                return;
            }

            var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            // Reset canvas để vẽ lại
            var width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
            var height = canvas.height = 250; // Set chiều cao cố định
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

            var maxVal = Math.max.apply(null, dataValues);
            if (maxVal < 5) maxVal = 5;

            var padding = 40;
            var bottomPadding = 30;
            var chartW = width - (padding * 2);
            var chartH = height - padding - bottomPadding;

            // Tính toán độ rộng cột (12 tháng)
            var gap = 10;
            var barWidth = (chartW / 12) - gap;

            // 1. Vẽ đường kẻ ngang (Grid)
            ctx.strokeStyle = "#f1f5f9";
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.beginPath();
            for(var i=0; i<=5; i++){
                var y = padding + (chartH/5)*i;
                ctx.moveTo(padding, y);
                ctx.lineTo(width - padding, y);

                // Vẽ số trục Y
                ctx.fillStyle = "#94a3b8";
                ctx.font = "10px sans-serif";
                ctx.textAlign = "right";
                // Viết số
                var valY = Math.round(maxVal - (maxVal/5)*i);
                ctx.fillText(valY, padding - 5, y + 4);
            }
            ctx.stroke();

            // 2. Vẽ Cột và Label
            dataValues.forEach(function(val, i) {
                // Tọa độ X
                var x = padding + (gap/2) + (barWidth + gap) * i;

                // Chiều cao cột
                var barHeight = (val / maxVal) * chartH;
                var y = (padding + chartH) - barHeight;

                // Vẽ cột
                if (val >= 0) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = "#3b82f6"; // Màu xanh
                    // Dùng fillRect thay cho roundRect để tương thích mọi trình duyệt
                    ctx.fillRect(x, y, barWidth, barHeight);

                    // Vẽ số liệu trên đỉnh cột (Nếu > 0)
                    if (val > 0) {
                        ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
                        ctx.font = "bold 11px sans-serif";
                        ctx.textAlign = "center";
                        ctx.fillText(val, x + barWidth/2, y - 5);
                    }
 }


                // Vẽ Label tháng (Trục X)
                ctx.fillStyle = "#64748b";
                ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
                ctx.textAlign = "center";
                // labels[i] đang là "Tháng 1", "Tháng 2"... lấy số thôi
                var labelText = (i + 1);
                ctx.fillText("T" + labelText, x + barWidth/2, height - 10);
            });
        }

        // --- 2. Hàm vẽ Donut Chart ---
        function drawDonutChart(dataItems) {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('donutChart');
            if (!canvas) return;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth * 2;
            const height = canvas.height = 500;
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

            const cx = width/2, cy = height/2;
            const r = Math.min(width, height)/3;
            let start = -Math.PI/2;
            let total = dataItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.Total, 0);
            const colors = ["#3b82f6", "#f97316", "#10b981", "#6366f1", "#ef4444"];

            dataItems.forEach((item, index) => {
                let p = total > 0 ? item.Total / total : 0;
                let sliceAngle = p * Math.PI * 2;
                let color = colors[index % colors.length];
                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, start, start + sliceAngle);
                ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.fill();
                start += sliceAngle;
            });

            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r*0.7, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fillStyle = "white"; ctx.fill();

            if (dataItems.length > 0 && total > 0) {
                 let maxItem = dataItems.reduce((prev, current) => (prev.Total > current.Total) ? prev : current);
                 let maxPercent = Math.round((maxItem.Total / total) * 100) + "%";
                 ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b"; ctx.font = "bold 40px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
                 ctx.fillText(maxPercent, cx, cy);
            }
            var legendContainer = document.getElementById('donutLegend');
            if (legendContainer && dataItems.length > 0) {

                dataItems.forEach((item, index) => {

        function drawBarChart(labels, dataValues) {
            // Đảm bảo ID khớp với HTML
            var canvas = document.getElementById('barChart');
            if (!canvas) {
                console.error("Không tìm thấy canvas #barChart");
                return;
            }

            var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            // Reset canvas để vẽ lại
            var width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
            var height = canvas.height = 250; // Set chiều cao cố định
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

            var maxVal = Math.max.apply(null, dataValues);
            if (maxVal < 5) maxVal = 5;

            var padding = 40;
            var bottomPadding = 30;
            var chartW = width - (padding * 2);
            var chartH = height - padding - bottomPadding;

            // Tính toán độ rộng cột (12 tháng)
            var gap = 10;
            var barWidth = (chartW / 12) - gap;

            // 1. Vẽ đường kẻ ngang (Grid)
            ctx.strokeStyle = "#f1f5f9";
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.beginPath();
            for(var i=0; i<=5; i++){
                var y = padding + (chartH/5)*i;
                ctx.moveTo(padding, y);
                ctx.lineTo(width - padding, y);

                // Vẽ số trục Y
                ctx.fillStyle = "#94a3b8";
                ctx.font = "10px sans-serif";
                ctx.textAlign = "right";
                // Viết số
                var valY = Math.round(maxVal - (maxVal/5)*i);
                ctx.fillText(valY, padding - 5, y + 4);
            }
            ctx.stroke();

            // 2. Vẽ Cột và Label
            dataValues.forEach(function(val, i) {
                // Tọa độ X
                var x = padding + (gap/2) + (barWidth + gap) * i;

                // Chiều cao cột
                var barHeight = (val / maxVal) * chartH;
                var y = (padding + chartH) - barHeight;

                // Vẽ cột
                if (val >= 0) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = "#3b82f6"; // Màu xanh
                    // Dùng fillRect thay cho roundRect để tương thích mọi trình duyệt
                    ctx.fillRect(x, y, barWidth, barHeight);

                    // Vẽ số liệu trên đỉnh cột (Nếu > 0)
                    if (val > 0) {
                        ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
                        ctx.font = "bold 11px sans-serif";
                        ctx.textAlign = "center";
                        ctx.fillText(val, x + barWidth/2, y - 5);
                    }
 }


                // Vẽ Label tháng (Trục X)
                ctx.fillStyle = "#64748b";
                ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
                ctx.textAlign = "center";
                // labels[i] đang là "Tháng 1", "Tháng 2"... lấy số thôi
                var labelText = (i + 1);
                ctx.fillText("T" + labelText, x + barWidth/2, height - 10);
            });
        }

        // --- 2. Hàm vẽ Donut Chart ---
        function drawDonutChart(dataItems) {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('donutChart');
            if (!canvas) return;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth * 2;
            const height = canvas.height = 500;
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

            const cx = width/2, cy = height/2;
            const r = Math.min(width, height)/3;
            let start = -Math.PI/2;
            let total = dataItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.Total, 0);
            const colors = ["#3b82f6", "#f97316", "#10b981", "#6366f1", "#ef4444"];

            dataItems.forEach((item, index) => {
                let p = total > 0 ? item.Total / total : 0;
                let sliceAngle = p * Math.PI * 2;
                let color = colors[index % colors.length];
                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, start, start + sliceAngle);
                ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.fill();
                start += sliceAngle;
            });

            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r*0.7, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fillStyle = "white"; ctx.fill();

            if (dataItems.length > 0 && total > 0) {
                 let maxItem = dataItems.reduce((prev, current) => (prev.Total > current.Total) ? prev : current);
                 let maxPercent = Math.round((maxItem.Total / total) * 100) + "%";
                 ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b"; ctx.font = "bold 40px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
                 ctx.fillText(maxPercent, cx, cy);
            }
            var legendContainer = document.getElementById('donutLegend');
            if (legendContainer && dataItems.length > 0) {
                var legendHTML = '';
                dataItems.forEach((item, index) => {
                    var color = colors[index % colors.length];
                    var percent = total > 0 ? Math.round((item.Total / total) * 100) : 0;
                    legendHTML += `
                        <div class="legend-item">
                            <div class="legend-color" style="background: ${color}"></div>
                            <span>${item.StatusName}: ${item.Total} (${percent}%)</span>
                        </div>
                    `;
                });
                legendContainer.innerHTML = legendHTML;
            }
        }
